description: A painted interior of a wooden office with a seated older man in a dark suit and bow tie at a desk, sorting coins beside an open ledger and inkwell. A bearded man in a dark coat and black hat leans over the desk placing coins, and a line of men in hats and coats waits at the left edge. Through a multi-pane window behind them, tents and blue-uniformed soldiers are visible on a camp ground. The clothing and setting suggest the 1860s. No readable text or frame is visible.
